Bulk actions work end to end. Screenshots under `prototypes/` (live: **http://maker:4001/bulk.html**).

**Selecting a few** (`shot-49-bulk-some.png`)
Each bookmark has a checkbox. As soon as one is ticked, a floating action bar appears showing **"2 selected"** and the group actions: **＋ Add tags**, **－ Remove tags**, **✓ Mark read**, **📖 Mark unread**, **🗄 Archive**, and **🗑 Delete** (in red), plus a ✕ to clear.

**The "everything that matches" twist** (`shot-50-bulk-allpage.png` → `shot-51-bulk-allmatch.png`)
When you select all the bookmarks currently on screen, a banner offers: **"Select all 137 bookmarks that match #reading."** Clicking it selects the *entire matching set across every page* — the bar then reads **"137 selected"** and any action applies to all 137, not just the 8 loaded. A clear "Clear selection" undoes it. So bulk actions respect your search/filter over the whole collection.

**Applying a group action** (`shot-52-bulk-addtags.png`)
Choosing "Add tags" (or "Remove tags") opens a small panel to pick the tags and **"Apply to N."** Delete on a group asks for confirmation ("Delete N permanently… use Archive instead if…"), consistent with the single-delete guard you approved.

A few points to confirm:

1. I mapped **"read/unread" to your Finished / To read** statuses — "Mark read" = Finished, "Mark unread" = To read. Is that the right mapping?
2. Is a **per-row checkbox that's always visible** the selection style you want, or would you prefer selection to appear only after you enter a "select" mode (keeping the list cleaner until then)?
3. For **group Delete**, I kept the same confirmation guard as single delete. Good?
4. Does **"select all that match"** (across every page) behave as you intended?
